source.question: When was well F-11 B completed, and how does its completion report's timing compare with when it started producing?

note: Reviewed Oct 29 (eval): every rejection was false and the run ended unverified on them: times of day ('14:15', '20:00') read as numbers, the report table's '30.Jun.2013' not read as a date, 'F-11 B' (the reports' wellbore) not matched with 'F-11' (the production data's name), '3 days' from a calculation (24 - 21) not taken as a duration. All fixed; every round is now accepted.

submission.summary: Well F-11 started producing on 2013-07-24, about 20 days after its Run Completion ended on 2013-07-04 and about 42 days before its Final Well Report was issued on 2013-09-04.

findings.claim: Well F-11 B’s Run Completion on MÆRSK INSPIRER ran from 2013-06-30 to 2013-07-04.
findings.detail: Final Well Report, Completion, 15/9-F-11 B page 5 operational timeline table lists Run Completion from 30.Jun.2013 to 04.Jul.2013 on MÆRSK INSPIRER, quote_check exact. Run Completion start activity noted as 30.06.2013 Completion.

findings.claim: Perforation of F-11 B finished on 2013-07-21, shortly before first oil on 2013-07-24.
findings.detail: Page 5 table: Perforation 09.Jul.2013 00:45 to 21.Jul.2013 23:00 MÆRSK INSPIRER quote_check exact. First oil for F-11 is 2013-07-24 with daily production on that date showing first oil volume.

findings.claim: The Final Well Report valid from 2013-09-04 was issued after first oil on 2013-07-24.
findings.detail: Report header: FINAL WELL REPORT Completion License NO PL046BS Well NO 15/9-F-11 B Valid from 2013-09-04 Rev 1:00 quote_check exact. Document issued 2013-09-04. First oil 2013-07-24. Gap from first oil to report is (31-24)+31+4 = 42 days; gap from Run Completion end 04.Jul to first oil 24.Jul is 20 days.
